power_model: Linear duty-equivalent power: rated_w * requested_percent / 100. This is an illustrative assumption, not a measured fan/dimmer power curve.
reference: Both modelled loads at 100% for exactly the same eligible intervals. This is an assumed full-power comparator, not measured conventional consumption.
interval_method: Left endpoint zero-order hold. Exclude final row, gaps over 60 seconds, embargo rows, and intervals crossing Phase 2 partitions.

auto_policy.description: COMFORT if CO2 >= 1100, or occupancy >= 2, or occupied and temperature >= 28; otherwise NORMAL if occupied, else ECO.

ventilation_guard: If CO2 >= 1100 ppm, applied ventilation may not fall below the original fuzzy request, even in ECO. Illustrative guard, not a safety or air-quality guarantee.
input_limit: Request percentages must be finite in [0,100]; environment thresholds are project choices. AUTO is deterministic rule-based adaptation, not learning.
interpretation: Energy and savings are simulated. No comfort validation, closed-loop environmental response or physical device control.
